youtube_title: Dandruff = Dry Scalp? Mostly Not | Body Fix #37 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #37. Black shirt... SNOW on your shoulders? And Mom says oil it, your scalp is dry!
Mostly B. A YEAST on the scalp + scalp oil = flakes.
For many people, heavy oiling FEEDS that yeast: more flakes.
Fix: Anti-dandruff shampoo, leave it 5 MIN, use regularly, go easy on oil.
Red flags: Red swollen sore scalp, no better in a month, rash elsewhere? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Dandruff
